notes.title: Six games for friends to celebrate release 'Moai 2: Path to Another World' on Steam!
notes.content:
Greetings, Friends!

Special for The Promised Land fans Buka Entertainment to celebrate thier new release on Steam Moai 2: Path to Another World want to give you a chance to get 6 games fo free!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/361950*Archievments and Trading Cards included

Also Buka makes a special price for owners first game of Moai: Build Your Dream
 https://pp.vk.me/c629102/v629102644/64d4/JHjguNQsMCY.jpg

You can grab 6 excellent casual  games :

MOAI 2: Path to Another World
Farm Frenzy: Hurricane Season
Season Match
Rescue Team
Locoland
Finders
Just change the sign * to correct number;)
[olist]
YNLTR-XN4RX-*QW7P
GVAE6-YY*GG-WJLL9
XP*GR-JNJX*-CYBHP
*B53*-XMT4Y-JH9EL
5HCWD-EIT*L-LCGGN
VP*F0-7BCFC-J5RKK
[/olist]

Good Luck, friends!  And pls don't be too greedy!;)ːredhotː
